business.headline: HUL takes Beco to Delhi HC over harmful chemicals claims against surf excel, VimHUL has approached the Delhi High Court against Beco's campaign targeting Surf Excel and Vim. The court has sought Beco's reply and will hear both sides before deciding interim relief.

India replaces Indonesia as Asia's least-preferred stock marketA Bank of America (BofA) survey found India has replaced Indonesia as Asia's least-preferred stock market. The result underlines investor unease over valuations, growth and limited AI exposure despite better earnings.

Can money really buy happiness? A report puts a number to itA latest report estimates India's income satiation level at about Rs 20 lakh a year. The finding suggests extra earnings matter less to life evaluation after that point.

Your SBI FDs may earn less after latest rate cut: Check new ratesSBI has cut interest rates by 25 basis points (bps) on domestic bulk term deposits of Rs 3 crore and above for select tenures. The revised rates came into effect on August 15, 2026, according to the bank's website.

IndiGo website hit by glitch, passengers unable to book ticketsPassengers trying to book IndiGo flights online reported technical problems with flight availability on the airline's website. In some cases, users saw a 'No Data Available' message, signalling a disruption in the booking process.
Sensex, Nifty slide as crude hits 3-week high, bond yields riseThe Nifty 50 fell 76.60 points, or 0.32%, to close at 24,078.30, while the BSE Sensex declined 325.78 points, or 0.42%, to 76,909.68.

Zepto's free delivery minimum rises to Rs 199, at par with Blinkit, SwiggyZepto has hiked its free-delivery minimum order value to Rs 199 from Rs 149 in select areas, joining rivals Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart as quick-commerce companies seek to improve profitability.

From $1.5 million to $76.8 million: India's chip startups see funding surgeThe numbers reveal how India's chip sector is maturing. Bigger cheques mean investors are more confident in the ability of these startups to deliver results.

Tata Sons just missed its AGM for the first time. Why is this a big deal?Tata Sons adjourned its 108th AGM after failing to meet the quorum requirement. The disruption shows how a dispute within Tata Trusts has reached the group's holding company.
SpiceJet welcomes NCLT relief as Aviator ML withdraws insolvency caseAviator ML's withdrawal gives SpiceJet some relief, but seven insolvency cases remain.
Beware: IT Department launches nationwide probe into suspicious foreign remittancesThe probe follows the identification of entities remitting large amounts abroad despite low or no reported turnover.

Shiprocket shares jump 43% after IPO: Buy, hold or book profits now?Shiprocket extended its listing rally, taking gains over the IPO price to 42.85%. The spike has prompted advice for allottees to book partial profits while holding the rest with a Rs 110 stop-loss.

Finally, some great news: Zerodha's Nithin Kamath welcomes Sebi's NRI investment pushSebi has proposed allowing NRIs to complete the account opening process digitally from their country of residence, without having to be physically present in India.

Govt rolls out incentives to expand PNG connectionsThe Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas said the incentive could help companies recover their investment in new connections in around three years, compared with about 10 years currently.

Man missed just 46 paise on credit card bill, charged over Rs 1,200 late feeA customer was charged over 2,600 times the 46 paise he fell short of on his credit-card bill, raising questions about how such tiny unpaid amounts are treated.

Shiprocket shares list at 35% premium at Rs 131 on NSEShiprocket listed on the BSE and NSE after its IPO drew strong investor demand. Attention now turns to its growth, profitability and ability to scale in the public market.

Make banking cool: Sitharaman wants state-run banks to crack the Gen Z codeFinance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman urged PSBs to shed their "government bank" image and become "cool" by offering personalised services, youth-focused perks and dedicated banking support.

300 calls a day, threats, home visits: When loan recovery turns into harassmentA missed EMI can lead to more than a payment reminder. Borrowers describe relentless recovery calls, threats, abusive language and agents visiting their homes and workplaces, sometimes contacting relatives, bosses and neighbours. Their accounts, shared with India Today Digital, show how loan recovery can cross the line into harassment. Their names have been changed to protect their identities.

Sensex, Nifty extend losses as crude, Middle East tensions weighThe BSE Sensex was down 117.94 points, or 0.15%, at 77,117.52, while the Nifty 50 fell 44 points, or 0.18%, to 24,110.90 as of 9:25 am. The Sensex opened at 77,218.05, while the Nifty opened at 24,152.05.

India's love affair with gold moves from jewellery to loansGold has always been more than just jewellery for Indian families. It is savings, security and sometimes a financial lifeline. But today, there is a new chapter in this long love affair: instead of simply holding on to gold, more Indians are using it to unlock credit.

entertainment.headline: Haiwaan song Mere Hero Hai Woh brings out Saif Ali Khan's softer side The first song from Haiwaan, titled Mere Hero Hai Woh, featuring actor Saif Ali Khan, focusses on an emotional narrative. Saif plays a visually challenged character in the upcoming film directed by Priyadarshan.

Actor Radhika Sarathkumar says she watched Suriya fight, overcome mental battles At the Vishwanath & Sons success meet, Radhika Sarathkumar said she had seen Suriya endure mental battles and overcome them. Her remarks underlined their long personal bond as the film posted a strong first week at the box office.

Shriya Saran's 5-year-old daughter objects to paparazzi, fans back her Shriya Saran's daughter grabbed attention during a recent outing in Mumbai as the actor attended the ISKCON temple with her family. The moment sparked a wider conversation online about children and paparazzi culture.

Isha Koppikar slams 'classic sophists' over twisting her 'proud andhbhakt' remark Actor Isha Koppikar has hit back at critics for twisting her "proud andhbhakt" remark on social media, insisting that patriotism, questioning governments, and policy disagreements can comfortably coexist.

Yash's Toxic gets harsher UK rating than Dhurandhar for sex, violence and gore Yash-starrer Toxic has received a harsher UK rating than Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar ahead of its August 26 release. The Geetu Mohandas directorial has drawn attention for its strong content, including violence, sex and injury detail.

Kala Hiran producer approaches Supreme Court in Salman's personality rights case Producer Amit Jani has approached the Supreme Court against a Delhi High Court order concerning his film Kala Hiran: The Battle for Legacy. The dispute turns on allegations that the film's promotional material commercially exploits Salman Khan's personality rights without authorisation.

Govinda once revealed his kundli had a 'second marriage' in old interview Govinda once said his kundali showed a "second marriage" in an old interview. The actor's remark has resurfaced as his marriage to Ssunita Ahuja faces fresh scrutiny.

Akshaye Khanna looks unrecognisable as Shukracharya in Mahakali. First glimpse out Akshaye Khanna's look as Shukracharya from Mahakali sets has been unveiled. The reveal positions the film as the next chapter in Prasanth Varma's cinematic universe following Hanu-Man (2024).

Don't day dream: Kangana hits back at Baba Ramdev over Gen Z remarks row Kangana Ranaut hit back at Baba Ramdev after he criticised her remarks on Gen Z and called her comments a sign of a corrupted mind. She also referred to the Supreme Court's 2024 action against Ramdev and Patanjali over misleading advertisements.

Hayden Panettiere death: Police report shows on-and-off boyfriend present at scene A police report reveals Brian Hickerson and his brother were present at Hayden Panettiere's South Carolina apartment when emergency services arrived. With an official cause of death yet to be established, authorities confirm the investigation into the actor's sudden death remains ongoing.

8 times Ssunita Ahuja publicly accused Govinda of cheating in marriage Ssunita Ahuja repeatedly spoke in public about Govinda's alleged affairs between November 2025 and August 2026. Her remarks kept their marriage in the spotlight even after her divorce petition was withdrawn on August 19.

Talk about Vijay's governance, not a woman: Actor Sanjjanaa on jibes at Trisha Actor Sanjjanaa Galrani defended Trisha after criticism over her presence at Tamil Nadu's Independence Day celebrations. She said the focus should remain on Vijay's governance, not on a woman or his personal life.

Why is internet so obsessed with Sterling Point when it's not a summer romance? Prime Video's Sterling Point follows Annie Jacobson as she discovers she has a sister she never knew about, and family secrets on a mysterious island. Its online appeal lies in how sisterhood, identity and longing matter as much as romance.

Bigg Boss Malayalam 7 winner Anumol marries Bhuvanesh Rajendiran at Guruvayur temple Anumol married Bhuvanesh Rajendiran in a private ceremony at Guruvayur Sree Krishna Temple in Thrissur. The wedding followed quiet pre-wedding hints online and drew a small circle of family and friends, including Suresh Gopi.

Yami Gautam is 'bhabhi daayan' in Nayyi Navelli, poster promises fantasy and chaos Amazon MGM Studios and Colour Yellow have set Yami Gautam Dhar's Nayyi Navelli for a theatrical release on October 16, 2026. The fantasy family entertainer is being positioned as a Dussehra big-screen outing built on humour, suspicion and chaos.

No divorce for Ssunita-Govinda. Manager confirms withdrawal of petition Ssunita Ahuja has withdrawn the divorce petition she had filed against Govinda, his manager said. The move comes after a public dispute that had drawn attention to their marriage.

Watch: Varun Dhawan buys new farm, celebrates with chai and biscuits Actor Varun Dhawan announced that he has bought a farm and marked it with chai and biscuits. The post drew warm reactions from fans as he called it the biggest achievement of his life.

Amid Toxic buzz, Kiara Advani says growth means saying yes to 'what scares you' Actor Kiara Advani revealed that playing Nadia in Toxic meant saying yes to things that scare her, addressing the online response to the film's trailer and the song Tabaahi. The statement follows co-actor Yash's recent comments on Aap Ki Adalat regarding their on-screen sequence ahead of the film's August 26 release.

K-drama actor Hong Min-gi faces dating violence allegations. What we know so far A woman claiming to be K-drama actor Hong Min-gi's former girlfriend has accused him of assault, threats and other misconduct. The allegations remain unverified, and Fable Company says it is preparing an official response.

general news.headline: Congress defies Centre's Vande Mataram protocol, sticks to 1937 two-stanza ruleThe Congress Working Committee has reaffirmed that only the first two stanzas of Vande Mataram will be sung at party programmes. The decision, rooted in a 1937 resolution, has returned to focus after BJP criticism of Mallikarjun Kharge.

Devendra Fadnavis now super CM? New rules give him sweeping power over ministersMaharashtra's new Rules of Business give Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis explicit authority to review, modify or overturn ministers' decisions in the public interest, with reasons recorded in writing. The rules also allow him to seek files directly from departments, strengthening his control while potentially fuelling friction within the Mahayuti coalition.

Drivers, plumbers evaluated govt exams? Naidu alleges exam anarchy under YSRCPAndhra Pradesh CM N Chandrababu Naidu alleged serious irregularities in the Group-1 examination conducted under the previous YSRCP government, citing forensic and CFSL findings. He claimed plumbers, drivers and other unauthorised personnel evaluated papers, while 718 of 734 answer scripts had alterations. Naidu said the alleged lapses undermined the examination's credibility and fairness.

Sugar prices hit record high as cane goes to E20; India rushes to contain crisisSugar prices in India's retail market have hit a record high even ahead of the festive season when demand peaks. The situation is so bad that India, a sugar exporter, is looking to import the kitchen staple. Experts are blaming the crisis on the diversion of sugarcane to produce ethanol, which the Centre is blending with petrol.

Tourists walk into Dehradun's Robber's Cave with boom box, dance to Haryanvi songsA viral video showed a group of men dancing through Dehradun's Robber's Cave with a boom box playing a Haryanvi song. The clip triggered criticism over tourist etiquette, loud music and behaviour at public attractions.

India edge Pakistan in Amstelveen thriller, reach Hockey World Cup 2nd roundIndia held off Pakistan's late charge to win a nerve-shredding match in Amstelveen. The result sent India into the World Cup second round and extended their long unbeaten run against their arch-rivals and eliminated them from medal contention.

Will govt relent, bring back E10 petrol? We are changingThe Centre has begun preliminary discussions on bringing back E10 petrol alongside E20, especially for vehicles manufactured before April 2023, reported The Indian Express newspaper. The report comes days after Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran said that E10 should be provided alongside E20. Is this a move to bring back E10 petrol?

NCERT names new Class 11, 12 Political Science panel with 4 RSS-linked membersNCERT has reconstituted a 20-member team to prepare new Political Science textbooks for Classes 11 and 12. The move advances NEP 2020 and NCF-SE 2023 implementation while draft books face layered review before publication.

Omar Abdullah reacts to tourist's old 'We are Gen Z' video after it goes viralOmar Abdullah has reacted to an old video showing a tourist confronting security personnel after a long halt at a Dras checkpoint.

J&K important part of India: US envoy Sergio Gor's big remark in SrinagarSergio Gor, on his first visit to Jammu and Kashmir since taking over as US envoy, asserted that America would reconsider downgrading its highest-level travel warning for J&K.

Politically finished, scared of Congress: Rahul Gandhi targets PM at CWC meetingAt the Congress Working Committee meeting, Rahul Gandhi attacked Prime Minister Narendra Modi and set out the party's political line. The discussion widened to youth unrest, Ayodhya donation allegations, China concerns and women's reservation.

Pak TikToker with 1.3M followers shot dead; 5th killing of woman influencer in a yearPakistani influencer Shamso Bibi, who had over 1.3 million followers on TikTok, was shot dead in Rawalpindi district's Taxila city on the country's Independence Day while she was travelling with her siblings. Her family has alleged that a financial dispute was behind her murder, but her killing comes amid rising violence against women influencers in Pakistan.

Don't day dream: Kangana hits back at Baba Ramdev over Gen Z remarks rowKangana Ranaut hit back at Baba Ramdev after he criticised her remarks on Gen Z and called her comments a sign of a corrupted mind. She also referred to the Supreme Court's 2024 action against Ramdev and Patanjali over misleading advertisements.

Thursday to be wet: Moving low-pressure system to bring monsoon rainA weather system moving across central India is keeping the monsoon active, with several regions facing another day of intense rainfall. Read where all it will rain on August 20.

Luxury cars stolen across India using duplicate keys, sold in Rajasthan; 2 arrestedBengaluru City Police arrested two people for allegedly stealing luxury cars using duplicate keys and selling them in Rajasthan. A stolen Rs 35-lakh Toyota Fortuner was recovered from Barmer. Police said the accused had been involved in 21 cases registered across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Rajasthan and Tamil Nadu.

Govt ranks ministers on social media performance; PM Modi tops chartThe Modi government's social media performance ranking, based on activity and engagement across Instagram, X and Facebook from May 1 to August 15, was presented at the Cabinet meeting, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi topping the list. The assessment comes amid a push to adopt more informal, youth-focused digital communication formats.

Lakshya falls to World No. 92, Ayush and Sindhu march into pre-quartersBWF World Championships: Lakshya Sen suffered a shock second-round exit to World No. 92 Garret Tan, while Ayush Shetty and PV Sindhu marched into the pre-quarters on Wednesday. Satwik-Chirag advanced without hitting a shuttle after receiving a walkover.

Pak threatens UK: Won't take back illegal migrants if child rapist is deportedPakistan has threatened to halt cooperation on the return of migrants from the UK over London's attempts to deport convicted child rapist and Rochdale grooming gang leader Shabir Ahmed to Pakistan. Islamabad has said Ahmed's crimes are a UK matter and warned that the dispute could damage wider bilateral cooperation.

Bengaluru footpath encroachments to be cleared by August-end, says ministerKrishna Byre Gowda has ordered officials to finish clearing footpath encroachments, waste and abandoned vehicles by August 30. The directive tightens enforcement against repeat violations and puts accountability on civic officials for lasting results.

Pakistan summons US envoy over Sergio Gor's 'J&K important part of India' remarkUS Ambassador to India Sergio Gor called Jammu and Kashmir an important part of India during his first Srinagar visit. Pakistan responded by summoning the US Chargé d'Affaires and said the remark departed from Washington's stated position.

Kala Hiran producer approaches Supreme Court in Salman's personality rights caseProducer Amit Jani has approached the Supreme Court against a Delhi High Court order concerning his film Kala Hiran: The Battle for Legacy. The dispute turns on allegations that the film's promotional material commercially exploits Salman Khan's personality rights without authorisation.

Class 10 students stab Telangana school principal 27 times for money; detainedTelangana police alleged that two minor former students killed school principal Roopa Reddy at her home in Nalgonda for cash. Investigators tracked them through CCTV footage, her final "Babu" clue and bloodstained currency notes recovered from one of the accused.

Gen Alpha students block highway over bad roads in UP, allege police misconductSchoolchildren in Uttar Pradesh's Mahoba district blocked the Jhansi-Mirzapur Highway to protest waterlogging and badly damaged approach roads. The demonstration ended after officials assured them their complaints and road repairs would be taken up.

19-year-old critical after doctors leave gloves, napkins inside during C-sectionA 19-year-old woman is in critical condition after her family alleged surgical gloves and paper napkins were left inside her abdomen during a C-section at Beed district hospital. The case has prompted a probe, show-cause notices and demands for action over alleged medical negligence.

sports.headline: ISL to start in October with 13 teams after Diamond Harbour miss deadline The Indian Super League (ISL) is set to begin in October with 13 teams after Diamond Harbour FC failed to meet the deadline to submit the required documents for the upcoming season. The club's absence means the league will proceed with a reduced number of teams.

Sri Lanka vs India: Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal to miss Colombo Test Sri Lanka head coach Gary Kirsten confirmed that the hosts will be without Kusal Mendis and Dinesh Chandimal for the second Test against India in Colombo. Top-order batter Pathum Nissanka is also a doubt, leaving Sri Lanka short of three first-choice batters for a must-win Test.

Lakshya Sen was very ordinary, no excuse for his loss to Garret Tan: Coach Garret Tan produced the biggest win of his young career, stunning Lakshya Sen in three games at the Delhi World Championships on Wednesday. But coach Vimal Kumar felt the Indian was passive, error-prone and far below his best.

SL vs IND: Saransh Jain likely to make India debut in Colombo Test Saransh Jain is on the verge of making his India debut in the second Test against Sri Lanka in Colombo, with the Madhya Pradesh all-rounder emerging as a strong contender for a place in the playing XI.

BCCI shifts Duleep Trophy final from Bengaluru to Chennai to allow spectators The BCCI has shifted the Duleep Trophy 2026-27 final from the Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru to the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai, allowing spectators to attend the marquee domestic fixture.

Gianni Infantino loses more support as FIFA official calls COO firing 'final straw' More national football federations and FIFA officials have withdrawn their support for president Gianni Infantino following the departure of COO Kevin Lamour, which one FIFA vice-president called the "final straw".

India edge Pakistan in Amstelveen thriller, reach Hockey World Cup 2nd round India held off Pakistan's late charge to win a nerve-shredding match in Amstelveen. The result sent India into the World Cup second round and extended their long unbeaten run against their arch-rivals and eliminated them from medal contention.

Satwik-Chirag advanced without hitting a shuttle after receiving a walkover.

Gary Kirsten breaks silence on Galle reunion with old pal Gautam Gambhir Gary Kirsten and Gautam Gambhir shared a long conversation on the sidelines of the Galle Test, but the meeting between the former India coach and his one-time player was not about their memories from the 2011 World Cup triumph.

KL Rahul wants India to build on confidence after passing Sri Lanka spin test KL Rahul said India's 165-run win over Sri Lanka reflected the progress they have made against spin, with the victory boosting the team's confidence ahead of the Colombo Test and next year's home series against Australia.

Hockey World Cup Highlights: India eliminate Pakistan to move into second round Ind Vs Pak Hockey World Cup 2026 Highlights: Braces from Harmanpreet Singh, Abhishek and a goal from Hardik Singh were enough for India to fend off a spirited performance from Pakistan to make it to the second round.

Don't drop Kuldeep: Pundits tell Gill, Gambhir to stick with spinner for ColomboVenkatesh Prasad and Cheteshwar Pujara have urged India to retain Kuldeep Yadav for the Colombo Test despite his muted Galle outing. Kuldeep picked up just one wicket across both innings in the first Test.

India's WTC push gathers pace after Galle Test win: What they need to do nowIndia beat Sri Lanka by 165 runs in the first Test in Galle to take a 1-0 lead in the series. The win earned India 12 crucial WTC points and revived their hopes of reaching the final after they finished third in the previous cycle.

Manav Suthar urged to preserve his strengths for Test cricket over IPL's richesManav Suthar's stunning start to Test cricket has prompted Cheteshwar Pujara to urge the young spinner to preserve his natural strengths in red-ball cricket and not alter his game for the riches and demands of the IPL.

Nick Kyrgios suspended from tennis after testing positive for cocaineNick Kyrgios has been provisionally suspended after testing positive for cocaine during the Mallorca Open. The case leaves him barred from the sport for now and adds to the uncertainty around his comeback.

BWF Worlds Highlights: Sindhu and Ayush into pre-quarters, Lakshya knocked outBadminton World Championships Highlights, August 19: A winning finish to the day! PV Sindhu beat Canada's Wen Yu Zhang 21-16, 21-17 in 35 minutes to storm into the pre-quarterfinals. Ayush Shetty also marched into the last 16 with a dominant 21-8, 21-10 win over Sri Lanka's Dumindu Abeywickrama. After heartbreak for Lakshya Sen and Unnati Hooda, Sindhu and Ayush give India something to smile about.

India conquer spin demon, renew WTC Final charge in GalleIndia overcame a stubborn Sri Lankan resistance on the final day to seal a 165-run win in the Galle Test. Manav Suthar picked up 6 wickets for 55 runs and guided India to a victory in the opening Test of the series.

Yashavsi Jaiswal rage baits Dickwella into throwing away his wicketYashasvi Jaiswal got under Niroshan Dickwella's skin with some cheeky banter during Sri Lanka's fourth-innings chase in the Galle Test. Dickwella appeared to take the bait, only to fall for 10 runs in the very next over.

Jamal Musiala reveals neurological issue after on-field collapse in pre-seasonJamal Musiala revealed he had been diagnosed with temporary, easily treatable absence seizures after collapsing during Bayern Munich's preseason friendly against Heidenheim, three days after a similar incident against RB Leipzig.

What happens if India loses to Pakistan at Hockey World Cup 2026?India's final Group D match against Pakistan isn't just about rivalry, but all about who makes it to the next round of the Hockey World Cup 2026. Harmanpreet and Co. will have their work cut out while taking on Pakistan.

1,800km trip, 30-point heartbreak. But, journey goes on for Ashith and AmruthaThey came to Delhi as reserves, leaving a tournament midway and travelling 1,800km for a World Championships debut. Seventy-one minutes later, the dream was over, but perhaps something bigger had begun for India's mixed doubles pair of Ashith Surya and Amrutha Pramuthesh.

1st Test Day 5 Highlights: Suthar's 10 wicket haul sees India win by 165 runsIndia (IND) vs Sri Lanka (SL) Highlights, 1st Test Day 5: India sealed a dramatic Test victory before rain arrived, with a dominant final-day performance ending Sri Lanka's resistance and giving the visitors a memorable win in their 600th Test.

Handshake or not, India face Pakistan at World Cup in a do-or-die situationIndia meet Pakistan in a must-win Hockey World Cup clash with even the pre-match handshake under watch. Beyond the symbolism, the result will decide knockout hopes and test India's tactical nerve.

Manjrekar, Kartik body-shame each other during commentary, video goes viralSL vs IND, 1st Test: Sanjay Manjrekar and Murali Kartik were involved in an awkward on-air exchange during the Galle Test, trading pointed jibes before acknowledging they were close to crossing the line.

Devdutt Padikkal refuses to look too far ahead amid India's No.3 competitionDevdutt Padikkal has made the most of his return to India's Test XI, scoring a maiden Test century in Galle. With Sai Sudharsan set to return, Padikkal remains focused on performing whenever opportunities come his way rather than looking too far ahead.

Barcelona sign Rodri from Manchester City on contract until June 2030Barcelona have signed Rodri from Manchester City on a deal until June 2030. The £65.4 million move ends his six-year spell at City after a decorated but injury-hit period.

Venus Williams, Gael Monfils named among wildcards for US OpenVenus Williams and Gael Monfils will return to the US Open singles main draw after receiving wildcards for the 2026 tournament. For Monfils, the appearance will be his final outing at Flushing Meadows.

Arjuna Award came late, but Gayatri and Treesa find rhythm at the right timeBWF World Championships: Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly's Arjuna Awards finally arrived six months late, on a day their form showed signs of returning. The Indian pair stunned 16th seeds Allison Lee and Lauren Lam of the USA in the second round.

Out or not out? Dhruv Jurel's catch of Lahiru Udara leaves cricket fans fumingDhruv Jurel's low catch to dismiss Lahiru Udara was given after a third-umpire review in Galle but not without controversy. Jurel and the third umpire was slammed by the fans for the dismissal of Udara, which pushed Sri Lanka further into trouble.

Vinesh Phogat calls Brij Bhushan goon and criminal, vows to fight in Supreme CourtIndian wrestler Vinesh Phogat has vowed to continue her legal fight against former WFI chief Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh after his acquittal in the sexual harassment case.

education.headline: The role of data analytics in modern advertising educationThis transformation also exercises a significant impact on the realm of 'advertising education.'

NCERT deletes Azad Pak, adds China's aggression reference in Class 12 textbookThe NCERT has made final changes to its Class 12 Political Science textbook syllabus for the upcoming academic year, including a revision in reference to India's border situation with China, Azad Pakistan, Article 370 and more.

NEET row: Bihar cops find 6 post-dated cheques 'issued for question paper brokers'Six post-dated cheques which were suspected to have been issued in favour of mafia demanding over Rs 30 lakh from each candidate seeking alleged leaked question paper ahead of NEET held last month were recovered by Bihar Police.

Forest fires surge tenfold from 2004 to 2017: Causes, impact and preventionAmidst a relentless surge, intense forest fires are now multiplying tenfold, casting a menacing shadow over our flora and fauna. Year by year, their fiery grip tightens, threatening ecosystems far and wide, now extending their reach to impact human lives.

Fresh plea in Supreme Court to recall NEET results, reconduct examsA fresh petition has been filed in the Supreme Court to recall the National Entrance cum Eligibility Test - Under Graduate (NEET-UG) 2024 results and re-conduct fresh examination after discrepancies in the declared results.

NTA issues clarification after NEET result controversy over toppers, high cut-offIn a detailed statement, the National Testing Agency (NTA) said that the increase in cut-off and number of toppers in the NEET-UG reflect the competitive nature of the exam and maintained that the test's integrity has not been compromised.

Exclusive: Arvind Kejriwal claims 'BJP succession war, PM backing Amit Shah'Speaking exclusively to India Today TV, Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal claimed that there is a "succession war" within the BJP. He also claimed that the ruling party is "not fighting the Lok Sabha elections as a team".

4 medical students arrested in Bihar for appearing as proxies for NEET aspirantsFour MBBS students who appeared in place of NEET aspirants in the medical entrance exam were detained in Bihar's Purnea.

NEET-UG question paper not leaked, claims baseless: National Testing AgencyThe reports claiming question paper leak in the medical entrance exam NEET-UG are "completely baseless and without any ground", the National Testing Agency (NTA) has clarified.
The generation with answers: Tech-savvy Indian youth tackling global challengesIndia's tech-savvy youth rewriting the global narrative, one solution at a time.

Left sweeps JNU students' polls, Dhananjay is first Dalit presidentThe Left swept the Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls, winning all four posts and trouncing the RSS-affiliated ABVP. The ABVP was leading at one point, but the Left eventually surged ahead and emerged victorious.
The power of knowledge: Education's influence on real estate market trendsIn a dynamic sector like real estate, investing in continuing education is not simply an option; it is a requirement.

JNU students' body election on March 22 after 4 yearsThe Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls will take place on March 22, more than four years after the last elections were held in September 2019.

UP 12th board exam math, biology papers leaked on WhatsApp, complaint filedThe mathematics and biology question papers for the Uttar Pradesh class 12 board exam were allegedly leaked on a WhatsApp group.

UP Police Constable recruitment exam cancelled days after paper leakThe Uttar Pradesh Police Constable recruitment exam held on February 17 and 18 was canceled due to a paper leak. The Chief Minister has announced a re-examination within the next six months.
Exam scams | Plugging the leaksA new central legislation aims to end the old scourge of exam paper scams for govt jobs, with heavy punishment and penalties
